title: Let me know which shows interest you most! #Broadway #Broadwayreview ...
transcript: Okay, so I need your help. I am disastrously behind on posting reviews on here and I have seen a ton of shows over the past month or two that I just have not gone around to making a video on. And it has gotten to the point where I cannot make a video on every single one of these shows. So I wanna hear from you guys. These are all of the shows that I've seen in the past month that I have not gotten a chance to make a video on. I have two coming up this week. Let me know which shows you're interested in hearing about and then whichever show is coming to the most or has the most likes, that's where I will start when I go to make my reviews. And the ones that aren't mentioned I probably won't get to. So choose wisely.
